scorecard.venue: Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium, Lucknow

batting.name: MR Marsh
batting.dismissal: c JG Bethell b JR Hazlewood

batting.name: AA Kulkarni
batting.dismissal: c RM Patidar b KH Pandya

batting.name: N Pooran
batting.dismissal: c KH Pandya b Rasikh Salam

batting.name: JG Bethell
batting.dismissal: c Prince Yadav b Mohammed Shami

batting.name: RM Patidar
batting.dismissal: c AK Markram b Shahbaz Ahmed

batting.name: JM Sharma
batting.dismissal: c RR Pant b Prince Yadav

batting.name: TH David
batting.dismissal: c DS Rathi b Shahbaz Ahmed

balls.text: sensational shot from Pant to finish the innings! Swings into position to play the reverse-swat and wallops the full ball over the deep third boundary
shot! Pant steps out and towards leg to make room and drills a low full toss to the wide long off boundary, Rasikh missed his yorker, LSG are past 200
slower one angling into Pant from around the wicket, he swivels and pulls, into the gap on the long leg boundary, one-bounce four
slower one wide outside off, driven through the covers for a single

caught right on the edge of the deep backward square leg boundary! Pooran cleared his front foot, swivelled and pulled with the angle into him from around the wicket, he made contact with the bottom of the bat though and Krunal took the catch this time
short and slow outside off, Pant plays a tennis-forehand and lofts towards deep point
full and wide again from Bhuvneshwar to end his spell, Pooran reaches for it and drives to deep point
Pant reached for the wide yorker and tried to slam it through cover but got a thick inside edge to drag it on the leg side
this time it's Pooran who loses grip of the bat as he slashes high towards deep backward point, Krunal runs in from the deep but drops it, it was another low full toss from Bhuvi wide outside off
the attempted wide yorker again, this time Pooran moves across towards the off and connects, slashing the ball past short third for a boundary
wide outside off, outside the tram lines but Pooran had also moved across his crease to try and reach it but missed
superb dive from Jordan Cox on the cover boundary to save two runs, Pooran had driven that with power and he perhaps thought it was going for four
tough night for Hazlewood, he finishes with another full toss outside off that Pant slams over the wide long off boundary, just about clears it
short ball down leg side, Pant swings at it and misses

low full toss and Pant swings across the line, lofting the ball to deep midwicket where Bethell comes sprinting in from the boundary to try and catch it, sensational effort but he can't hold on ... he seems to have hurt his finger, it's bleeding and he's off the field, will have to wait and see if it impacts his batting, doesn't look good
the bouncer is too high from Hazlewood, too high for Pant to connect with his hook

Hazlewood misses the wide yorker again and bowls a full toss outside off, Pant swings so hard at it, slashing the ball to the point boundary and losing grip of his bat in the process and flinging it towards the leg side
full toss down leg side, Hazlewood misses the yorker, Pant gets down low and gets a bit of bat on it while trying to paddle, gets a boundary to find leg
Pant charges at Hazlewood and swings across the line, and gets beaten, he tried this the previous time these teams met and suffered a painful blow on the elbow

caught at deep point! Marsh didn't really get going after the resumption, he's carved this low full toss flat and hard, Bethell catches it just above his head, he walks off to a big round of applause from his team-mates
Pooran is ready for the short of a length ball angling across him from over the wicket this time, he moves across to the off side and pulls hard, lofting the ball high and far over deep midwicket
dropped by Padikkal running in from the long on boundary! Marsh mis-timed a full toss down the ground, Padikkal covered a lot of ground to get to the catch but spilled it as he tumbled forward
short of a length angling across the left-hander from over the wicket, pace-off delivery, Pooran pulls to deep midwicket
blockhole from Bhuvi, Marsh can only drive it down the ground to long off
wide yorker again, Pooran digs it out on the off side for a single, pretty quiet since the resumption
full ball in the blockhole outside off, steered to short third
steps out to a slower length ball and swings across the line, pulling to deep midwicket
strays down leg side and concedes a wide
that's the third time Pooran has pinged the point boundary tonight, Rasikh misses the yorker this time, and Pooran opens the face and punches the low full toss through point
in the blockhole outsidde off, Marsh digs it out through point
nearly in the blockhole again from around the wicket angling into the left-hander, Pooran chips it down to long on
full ball outside off, nearly in the blockhole, driven through covers for a single
slower ball around off stump, back of the hand, Pooran steps forward and defends on the off side for a single
20 runs off the over ... Marsh launches the last ball - a full and wide one - with a powerful drive flat and over the cover point boundary
the offcutter outside off stump, that spun back a fair bit too, just inside the wide line, Marsh let it go

century off 49 balls for Mitch Marsh! He celebrates by taking off his helmet and raising his arms to the dugout. Shepherd gave him a low full toss outside off stump, and Marsh slashed it with force to the backward point boundary
full and straight, and Marsh goes hard and straight, smashing the ball back over the bowler's head, piercing the gap between long on and off
Marsh throws his bat hard at it and gets a bit of an inside edge, dragging the ball through midwicket
full ball down leg side, Marsh misses the whip off the pads but the ball goes off his pad between the keeper and short fine leg to the boundary
sensational comeback from Krunal after that six, what a competitor! His last ball is a bouncer that Marsh pulls to deep midwicket
hit off the backfoot to point
fired in fast outside off, Marsh tries to cut and gets beaten, Pooran goes up to Marsh to have a word to him
bowled from a low release wide outside off, Marsh gets beaten
bangs in the bouncer wide outside off, Marsh lets it go, third bouncer of his spell
bowled flatter and wider outside off, Marsh goes back and cuts hard towards deep third, wide enough to come back for the second
add six more to his analysis! Marsh clears his front foot and launches a full one high and far over the straight boundary, first six after the resumption
top comeback over from Hazlewood, Marsh digs out the yorker to long on for the sixth single in the over, Hazlewood is back Hazlewooding
clipped off the pads towards long on for a single
in the blockhole outside off, Marsh stays back and hits it through point
nearly in the blockhole from around the wicket to the left-hander, Pooran hits it along the ground to long on
in the blockhole, Marsh jams his bat down on it and digs the ball out towards extra cover, Patidar dives to his right but can't stop it entirely
good length but a tough too straight, Pooran clips off his pads through midwicket
Rasikh finally gets the yorker in the blockhole, he was aiming for it both the times he bowled half-volleys at Pooran and got hit for four, Marsh digs this one back to the bowler
short of a length and at the body, Pooran swivel-pulls behind square
once more! Pooran leans forward to a half-volley and drives along the ground again, this time he beats deep point to his left, the previous ball was to his right
that is some timing, Pooran square drives the full ball from outside off stump and hits that sweetly along the ground to the point boundary
cut off the back foot through point for a single
slower ball from around the wicket, Pooran stays in his crease and dabs the ball towards point
punched off the front foot into the covers, Krunal completes a tight over after the resumption
bowled flat and straight, Marsh plays it off his pads in front of square leg, Jitesh has to chase after the ball himself from behind the stumps
another boundary, two in the cover from Krunal, Pooran plays a tennis-smash down the ground towards long on
Krunal stoops really low in his run up and then bangs in the bouncer at Pooran, who lets it go through to the keeper
he's hit that to the fielder at cover again, in the air this time, and Kulkarni's laboured stay at the crease is finally over, he came down the pitch and swung the ball hard straight to Patidar
nails the cover drive, he hit that really well, but straight to the fielder at cover
steps out of his crease and lofts the ball, falls between the inner circle and the long off boundary, no power on it at all
a fuller ball on off stump, driven to long off for a single
dragged it short and Marsh heaves the ball into the gap on the wide-long on boundary with a pull shot
Kulkarni throws his bat at it and hits the wide ball towards deep cover
bowled flat and a bit short, Marsh pulls along the ground to the fielder at cow corner
steps out and drives the ball along the ground to deep midwicket
tries to turn the ball on the leg side but gets an edge on the off
width on offer outside off, quicker ball at 113 kph, Marsh throws his hands hard at it and slashes it flat and powerfully over backward point
low full toss, driven along the ground to wide long off
played back to the bowler, Kulkarni is trying to make room but can't find his gears
backs away towards leg and slaps the ball into the covers, can't find the gap
pushed to long on for a single
zipped it through outside off, a flipper like delivery, Kulkarni was late on the cut and lucky that ball was not on his stumps
played gently into the covers
first boundary for Kulkarni, and it's about time too! A lovely late cut to a short ball outside off, finding the gap on the backward point boundary
another huge drag down but Marsh mistimes the smash and plays it to long off
dragged it short and Marsh has helped himself to another monster six, he's pulled that ball with tremendous power over deep midwicket
punched off the back foot through point
driven uppishly but in the gap between two fielders in the cover point region, slightly slower from Hazlewood and Marsh played the drive a bit too early
another full ball, outside off, Marsh tries to hammer the leather off the ball but mis-times it into the covers
pulls the short of a length ball but can't beat midwicket
streaky this time, he wanted to hit that full ball down the ground but was caught in his crease and got an inside edge that went between the keeper and short fine leg
just a bit of width outside off and Marsh stands tall and slashes hard, cutting the ball with tremendous force to the deep third boundary to bring up his fifty off 20 balls
good length angling into off stump, Marsh punches towards point from his crease
low full toss on middle and off, looking for the yorker, Kulkarni hits it to cover ... he's got to get going now, or leave it to the others after him, LSG have to be scoring at both ends
tries to turn the ball through square leg but misses and gets hit on the thigh
waits for the slower one this time, short of a length outside off, and hammers the back-foot cut through point
Marsh is beaten by a slower one outside off, played too early

down the ground this time and all the way for another six ... but hang on, has Jordan cox pulled off a blinder of a save? He's caught it as the ball was falling over the long-off boundary and flicked it back into play, but his foot had touched the boundary while he had contact with the ball
fetch that says Marsh! That is a colossal pull shot off the front foot to a short one, 97 metres and over the deep square leg boundary
punched into the covers to end the over with a dot
driven to long off for a single
look at the air time on that shot! High and far over the wide long-on boundary. Straighter line from Krunal and Marsh clears his front foot and swings like he's on a golf course
Krunal gives Marsh width and the ball disappears to the cover boundary, fierce drive
Marsh swings hard at one that angles into him and gets an inside edge to square leg
bowled slowly and full from around the wicket into the right-hander, Kulkarni tries to clip it to the leg side but gets a leading edge through covers
too full and too wide outside off, exactly where Marsh likes it, he frees those big, strong arms of his and flays the ball high and far over cover for his third six
full ball outside off, driven through the covers on the front foot
whoops, a high full toss just below the waist, wet ball? Kulkarni swings it off his hips to midwicket
he's hit this much harder right back at the bowler and Bhuvi can't hold on! It was a length ball around off that Kukarni met on the front foot and just smashed back at the bowler
Kulkarni tries to hit this with power but mis-times the loft down the ground, but manages to get enough on it to just clear mid-off
good length around off, driven firmly to mid off on the front foot
Hazlewood shortens his length around off stump, Marsh stays in his crease and opens the face to steer behind point
Hazlewood goes fuller again and Marsh goes big again, just like the previous six, planting his foot forward and lofting straight through the line over the bowler's head
Marsh steps out to a short of a length ball, trying to unsettle Hazlewood, he gets hit high on the bat handle while trying to turn the ball on the leg side
that one kept a touch low and angled into Marsh, who stayed in his crease and pushed into the covers
good length this time, angling into the right-hander from outside off, Marsh stays in his crease and plays on the leg side
he's hit straight through the line, back over the bowler's head all the way for six! Hazlewood over-pitched on that occasion, on a straighter line too, allowing Marsh to loft on the up
Marsh steps out of his crease a bit too early, Hazlewood bangs it in short of a length wide outside off and seams it away, far away from Marsh who had moved outside leg
that elegant flick again, moves smoothly across his crease and picks the ball off the pads and sends it along the ground to deep backward square leg, not trying to over-hit it just yet
good length outside off stump, Kulkarni moves forward and punches towards point
strays on to the pads, Kulkarni leans across his crease and plays a languid flick behind square leg
wider line outside off, Kulkarni strides forward and shoulders arms to his first delivery of the season
punched to mid-on, that was on a straighter line and the length a little fuller
pitches short of a length around off with swing away from the right-hander, that could have been the first ball of a Test match, Marsh lets it go

just the single to long off, LSG have a win at long last, a win after eight losses at home, a win after six losses this season, they are still at No. 10 in the points table but there will be some relief in their camp tonight
swung hard but he does not time it well, just the two to deep backward square leg
Shepherd finally makes contact but only gets a four to backward square leg, that's not good enough for RCB at this point
he mixes it up by firing this one fast and wide outside off stump, a bit too wide though, Pant reaches to his right to collect and whips off the bails but Shepherd is safe
another slow googly, another swing across the line from Shepherd and another miss, Rathi is walking the talk in this final over
bowled flatter and wider outside off, Krunal slaps the ball to deep cover, just the single ... LSG are so close now
angles the ball slow and into Shepherd, who has a mighty heave on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pad, the ball goes on the off side, that was the googly
Prince bowls a crucial dlivery, hits the wide yorker, Shepherd digs it out towards long on
Shepherd finally connects and in some style, launching a full toss high and far over the deep midwicket boundary, Prince was looking for the yorker and missed his length
short of a length and this one skids through on Shepherd, who misses again, kept a touch low and beat Shepherd's pull on the bottom edge
backs away and drives the ball through cover for just the single
Krunal does not miss! Clears his front foot and hooks again, hitting the short ball with power into the gap on the deep square leg boundary
full toss on the pads and Shepherd has missed out on this big time! He fails to connect with his swing and gets hit on the pads, that should have been in the stands!
Krunal Pandya! Shami bangs in the short one and Krunal hangs back and hooks, sending the ball soaring over deep square leg
full toss and it's been powered over the long-on boundary, Krunal lined it up and swung hard, Shami missed his yorker
full and straight, looking for the blockhole, Shepherd hits it to long on
the slower short one this time outside off, Shepherd tries to upper cut to deep third but is beaten by the change of pace
banged in short outside off, the batter lets it go through to the keeper!
short of a length angling across the left-hander, cut off the back foot through point
lets a wide one go outside off and Shepherd is not happy that the umpire has not called it wide, he can review it if he wants but decides not to
two in a row, this time Shepherd goes back and cuts through backward point and finds the gap on the boundary
Shepherd gets going by dabbing a short of a length ball late to the deep third boundary, beating short fine to his left
caught at cover point! Well that's a rather tame dismissal in the end, the ball was shortish and wide and within David's reach, he went for it and hit it straight to Rathi in the circle
just a bit closer to David's swinging arc and the length is too short, he clears his front foot and launches the ball over long on for six
wide again outside off, David moves towards it and swings wildly, he misses, the umpire calls it wide again
too wide outside off this time
tries to bash the ball through the off side, gets a bottom edge into the off side and David refuses the single! He's going to go after Shahbaz here
short once again outside off this time, David gets a thick edge to deep third, trying to slash the ball on the off side
again! Flat over deep midwicket this time, David is expecting the short ball from Mayank and he absolutely nails the pull
David was ready and waiting for the short one this time, clearing his front foot, hammering the pull deep into the stands beyond deep square leg
short and sharp outside off stump, David slashes at it but misses
a much quicker short ball skids into David and cramps him for room and time as he misses the pull and gets hit on the thigh
short of a length with too much width outside off, David stands tall and muscles the ball to the cover boundary with a powerful punch off the back foot
cut off the back foot this time and into the gap on the point boundary, too short and too wide from around the wicket, slanting across the left-hander
cut off the front foot to point
reverse swats it to point, got into position a bit too early and had to wait because the bowler slower it up
wide outside off again, flatter trajectory and shorter length, David swats it to deep cover
he lets it go outside off this time because it's so wide
full and wide, trying to keep it away from David's hitting arc but he's got a big arc ... he swings so hard and launches the ball flat down the ground for a one-bounce four
cut really hard off the back foot and that would have been four had Kulkarni not dived to his right at point and made the save in the infield
steps out of his crease and drills the ball to long off
bowled short of a length and wide outside off, David reaches for it and slaps it to deep cover
presses forward and drives the ball to long off
bowled quick at the body, David mis-times the pull towards deep midwicket
fired into the pads, David moves back and tries to force the ball on the leg side, gets a thick inside edge that goes between his legs and to the fine leg boundary
cut off the back foot to point, there's a mix up between the batters but it ends well
punched to long off for a single
fired wide outside off, beaten on the cut
cuts one that slants across him to short third

Aiden Markram with the catch running in from the long off boundary, and is that the game for LSG? Shahbaz has picked up the massive wicket, he dug in the ball flat and slightly short outside off, Patidar came forward and flat-batted it down the ground, Markram covered good ground and tumbled forward as he took the catch
shorter length but the line is still too wide, David bottom edges his shot into the ground on the off side
bowled full and wide from around the wicket to the right-hander, David uses his long reach and drives the ball with so much power, beating the fielder running to his left from long off
full and straight, David moves across his crease and taps the ball through midwicket

Prince is having a superb night! He follows up the slower short one with a quicker bouncer, hurrying Jitesh for time, he is late on the pull shot and ends up top-edging it in the air and over the keeper, Pant runs back and judges the catch well
pace-off short ball, Patidar pulls towards long on, that hit the bottom of the bat
full ball, looking for the blockhole, Jitesh whips it off his pads in front of square leg
good length skidding towards off stump, defends from the crease on the off side

caught and bowled! Snaps the partnership just short of a 100! The short of a length ball grips the surface and stops on Padikkal, who plays too early and ends up chipping the ball back at Prince, he catches it above his head
length again from Mayank, it sits up and Patidar swats it to the wide long on boundary, giving Markram lots of work to do running to his right from long on
slower ball, Padikkal pulls too early and gets an inside edge on to his pad
short of a length at the body, Patidar jumps across and chips the ball in the air over square leg, falls well short of the fielder in the deep
Patidar is on the rampage now, length again from Mayank and Patidar slams it high and far over deep midwicket, that's travelled 101 metres!
Mayank bowls length and Patidar goes long, gets a touch inside the line, swivels and swings, sending the ball soaring over deep backward square leg to bring up his half-century off 26 balls
the bouncer to Patidar but it's too high this time, wide
the slower one on a fuller length angling across Padikkal who waits and steers to deep third
a bit too short, a bit too straight, but there's nothing bitty about this shot from Patidar, he clears his front foot and pulls with immense power, high and far over deep square leg
bowled into the pads and Patidar misses the pull and gets hit on the pad

Patidar has launched this high into the Lucknow sky and when it comes down it just clears Markram on the edge of the straight boundary, Rathi bowled a fullish ball and Patidar simply cleared his front foot and swung hard
bowled flat and short, across the left-hander from over the wicket, Padikkal flat-bats it towards long on
fires this down leg side, Padikkal tries to swing it behind square but misses and is hit on the pad
bowled full and wide outside off, too much width from Rathi, Padikkal leans forward and lofts the ball over cover and to the boundary
142.8 kph, short, sharp and straight, Patidar sways outside the line and tries to chip it down to deep third but is late and beaten
he's timed this all right, 145.9 kph on a length, Patidar meets it on the front foot and pulls over the cow corner boundary
the slower one at 108 kph, full and slow in the slot, Patidar swings hard at it and mis-times it down the ground
144.3 kph, the short one rises into Patidar's ribs, he hops back on to his toes and defends in a hurry, rushed for time
bounces him, 140.4 kph, Patidar plays a flaky pull and gets beaten
short of a length and straight, Padikkal hops back and opens the face to steer to deep third
short and wide outside off, terrible ball with third in the circle, Patidar helps himself to a boundary by cutting to deep third
another short ball on leg stump, Padikkal pulls off his pads to deep square leg
cut off the back foot through point and they have enough time to run the second before the fielder gets to it from sweeper cover
nudged towards midwicket for a single
half-tracker from Rathi and Patidar clears his front foot and mows it over the deep midwicket boundary
darted across the left-hander from over the wicket, Padikkal cuts late, Prince moves quickly to his left and dives to make a one-handed stop and save the boundary
gets on top of another short ball and rolls his wrists to pull it behind square leg
short ball and Padikkal dismisses it to the cow corner boundary by swivelling and pulling with authority
short of a length around off stump, Patidar stays in his crease and punches behind point
played off the back foot towards deep point
lofted off the pads, fuller length ball from Prince and Padikkal has launched it high but not far enough to reach the square leg boundary, falls wide of the fielder running around from long leg
short of a length angling into the right-hander, punched to mid off for a single
Shami brings his line closer to the left-hander from around the wicket to cramp Patidar on the back-foot punch, played into the covers
steps forward and towards the leg side to create room and lofts the ball over wide mid-off for a boundary
pushed towards point for a single
that kept low! Patidar was rooted to his crease and had to try and defend in a hurry as the ball angled into him instead of seaming away, that just missed off stump
beaten outside the off stump, Shami shortens his length and nips it away from the right-hander
driven beautifully through the covers! Stands in his crease, pressing forward and punches a length ball with perfect timing to the boundary
short ball again to end the over, played in front of point for a single
pace down to 137.2 kph but Patidar still looked hurried on that pull shot as the short one rushed him for time, hits it into the gap on the deep square leg boundary
a fuller length angling into the pads at 147.6 kph, Patidar clips in front of square leg
another searing short of a length ball that zips past Patidar at 145kph as he goes back to defend
short of a length and rising into Padikkal's ribs at 142.2 kph, he gets on his toes and plays it down on the leg side, riding the bounce
fires it across the left-hander from over the wicket, that kept a touch low and beat Padikkal on the cut shot, the speed gun says 150.1 kph!
jumps back and drops the short of a length ball towards point
short of a length angling into the left-hander from around the wicket, played off the back foot to short third
nudged off the back foot behind point for a single
defended into the off side
Test match beauty from Shami, hitting a good length around off with an upright seam and nipping away to beat the outside edge of Patidar's prod from the crease
jumps back in his crease and steers to deep third again
takes two steps out and opens the face to run a short of a length ball with the angle across him to deep third
swung off the hips, with front foot foot in the air, all the way over deep backward square leg for the first six of the chase!
punched off the back foot to midwicket
this one shapes away from outside off stump, Patidar prods forward and opens the face to steer to third man

off stump is on the ground and look at Prince Yadav go! 140 kph, upright seam, pitching on a good length outside off, drawing Kohli forward, nipping back into the right-hander, beating the inside edge and knocking off stump out of the ground, sensational ball! Prince is pumped!
good length angling into the right-hander from over the wicket, Kohli gets behind the line and blocks
stays rooted to his crease and swishes at a short of a length ball and seams away, he gets beaten

quick redemption for Prince Yadav! Runs to his left from deep third and holds on to a swirling catch! Bethell was aiming to hit the ball down the ground with the booming lofted drive but got a thick outside edge as the length ball seamed away from him outside off stump

that is a shocker from Prince Yadav at deep backward point, Bethell plays a sweet back-foot punch, opening the face to steer the ball behind point, Prince runs to his left from deep third and makes a mess of it
overcorrects and strays on to the pads, Bethell misses the glance and the ball goes off his pad towards fine leg
full and wide with seam movement away from Bethell as he aims for the big booming cover drive, too wide again
bat on ball for the first time in the chase, Bethell defends into the off side
too wide again from Shami outside off, Bethell tries to cut but can't reach it
superb ball, pitches on a good length closer to off stump and seams away, beating the outside edge of Bethell's bat as he tries to defend
short of a length with some movement away from the left-hander from around the wicket, a slip in place too, Bethell cuts and misses
